title: 第1章 第一序列顾长歌亿万倍返还系统第2章 重生回来的至尊族妹
slug: 玄幻长生神子何须妹骨证道
content_zh:
三千道域。
中天道域，中州。
长生顾家，第一序列府邸内，一名刚满十六岁的少年蓦然睁开了双眸，眸中好似有无数画面闪过。
“我这是……穿越了？还是胎穿？”
“十六岁，也就是现在觉醒宿慧？”
顾长歌脑海中出现风暴，前世今生的记忆交错让他有点茫然。
不过下一秒，他就会恢复正常了。
“没想到，我竟然真的穿越了，而且还穿越到了一个玄幻世界中，成为一个长生世家的第一序列的真龙子。”
“可惜十六岁才觉醒宿慧，不然的话我就能凭借先知觉醒做出更多的事情，说不定已经钦定神子之位了！”
在顾长歌记忆中，长生顾家第一序列并不代表就一定成为神子。
只能说第一序列代表在十位序列中，资质，天赋以及战力暂时为最顶尖，争锋三年，看十八岁后才是决定神子之位的时候。
十位序列来自长生顾家各大支脉。
而顾长歌则是代表主脉！
正常情况下来说，基本上都是由主脉真龙子成长为长生顾家神子，不过这一世倒是有点意外发生。
那便是长生顾家各大支脉皆有无上妖孽出世！
肉身成圣：荒古圣体！
悟性超凡：先天道体！
甚至于还有七窍玲珑心，苍天霸体等等。
而顾长歌，他便是身具重瞳，并且根骨极佳，丝毫不逊色于各种圣体，道体，神体，唯一差别便是没有伴生神通。
不过重瞳便已经给顾长歌带来无敌之资了。

整理完所有信息，顾长歌嘴角微微扬起：“这个身份，这个资质，这个背景，好家伙，直接就是王炸开局啊！”
说着，顾长歌又眨了眨眼，确认自已没有什么奇怪的面板，提示音又吐槽。
“可惜，身为穿越者，我竟然没有绑定金手指！”
“不过也无所谓！”
“凭借现在资质底蕴，我也有信心走上无敌路！”
顾长歌刚说完，正准备安抚心中激荡。
下一秒，一道提示音，顿时让他双眸不由微微瞪大。
【叮，检测到宿主觉醒宿慧，无敌返还系统开启！
【恭喜宿主获得《新手无敌返还大礼包》！
提示音在脑海中响起，并且一个提示信息界面也出现在眼前，让顾长歌可以清晰的知道，他还真的有系统！
不是。
他就随口说说而已，真来系统啊！
content_en:
Three thousand realms.
Zhongtian Dao Domain, Zhongzhou.
In the first sequence of the Changsheng Gu family's mansion, a young man who had just turned sixteen suddenly opened his eyes, and countless images seemed to flash through his eyes.
"Am I... traveling through time? Or am I pregnant?"
"Sixteen years old, that is, when you awaken to Su Hui now?"
A storm appeared in Gu Changge's mind, and the intertwined memories of his past and present life made him a little confused.
But in the next second, he will return to normal.
"Unexpectedly, I actually traveled through time, and also traveled into a fantasy world, becoming the first true dragon son of an immortal family."
"It's a pity that I didn't awaken to Su Hui until I was sixteen. Otherwise, I would have been able to do more things with the awakening of the prophet. Maybe I would have been appointed the Son of God!"
In Gu Changge's memory, being the first person in the Gu family's order of longevity does not necessarily mean that he will become the Son of God.
It can only be said that the representatives of the first sequence are among the top ten in terms of qualifications, talents and combat power. They will compete for three years and the position of the Son of God will be decided after the age of eighteen.
The ten-digit sequence comes from the major branches of the Changsheng Gu family.
And Gu Changge represents the main line!
Under normal circumstances, the true dragon son of the main line would basically grow into the immortal son of the Gu family, but something unexpected happened in this life.
That means that all major branches of the Changsheng Gu family have the birth of supreme monsters!
Sanctification of the physical body: the ancient holy body!
Extraordinary understanding: innate Taoist body!
There are even the Seven Apertures Exquisite Heart, Heavenly Tyrant Body, etc.
As for Gu Changge, he has double pupils and excellent bones. He is not inferior to various holy bodies, Taoist bodies, and divine bodies. The only difference is that he does not have the accompanying supernatural powers.
However, the double pupils have already given Gu Changge invincibility.
After sorting out all the information, Gu Changge raised the corner of his mouth slightly: "With this identity, this qualification, and this background, good guy, he is the king of the game!"
With that said, Gu Changge blinked again to confirm that there was no strange panel, and the prompt sounded again.
"It's a pity that as a time traveler, I didn't bind the golden finger!"
"But it doesn't matter!"
"With my current qualifications, I am confident that I will be on the road to invincibility!"
Gu Changge had just finished speaking and was about to calm down the turmoil in his heart.
The next second, a notification sound made his eyes widen slightly.
[Ding, it is detected that the host awakens Su Hui, the invincible return system is activated!
[Congratulations to the host for receiving the "Newbie Invincible Return Gift Pack"!
A prompt sounded in his mind, and a prompt information interface also appeared in front of him, allowing Gu Changge to clearly know that he really had a system!
no.
He was just talking casually, but he was really systematic!
